mdMessage.title: Message from Managing Director
mdMessage.subtitle: Building a Future Grounded in Honor & Transparency
paragraphs: Dakhina Real Estate (Pvt.) Limited was incorporated as a Joint Stock Company in 2004 as a private limited company. My father, the Late Syed Panaul Haque was the founder Chairman, and my wife Mona Haque was the Managing Director. After his demise, I voluntarily retired from my active service in the Bangladesh Armed Forces to take over full executive responsibility.

Dakhina City was his dream project — a family-owned business established on legal purity. Today, Mrs. Mona Haque is our Chairman, I serve as Managing Director, and Syed Tajwar Azam along with Syeda Salwa Azam serve as Directors. We commenced consolidated land procurement at this strategic location in 2004.

The legal authenticity and documentation genuineness of our project is unquestionable. We take pride in building communities where respected military officers, civil dignitaries, and expatriate families invest with absolute peace of mind.

about.intro: Dakhina Real Estate (Pvt) Limited (DREL) is a premier property development conglomerate dedicated to delivering master-planned townships with supreme environmental and infrastructural standards. Known throughout the country as the 'Architect of Trust', we take pride in bridging aspiration and reality.

news.title: Dakhina Group Concludes Milestone Residential Liaison with BAF Welfare Trust
news.summary: Formal ceremony held at Dakhina Tower reaffirming dedicated sector allocations and fast-track development timelines for defense personnel.
news.content: Dakhina Group management welcomed senior officials from the Bangladesh Air Force Welfare Trust to formalize operational benchmarks for the upcoming residential clusters in Dakhina City.

news.title: 100-Foot Main Access Boulevard Paving Reaches Final Milestone
news.summary: Direct four-lane link connects Dakhina City with Uttara Sector 18 and the Dhaka Metro Rail Line 6 northern terminal.
news.content: Engineers confirmed that the primary 100-foot central spine road is now fully graded, facilitating transit times of under 10 minutes from Maskat Plaza.

news.title: Dedicated Expatriate Advisory Wing Established for UK, US, and Australian NRBs
news.summary: Offering virtual 360-degree site walkthroughs and embassy-attested documentation services.
news.content: Over 200 non-resident Bangladeshis have registered plots with Dakhina Group. The new desk streamlines power-of-attorney execution and installment management across time zones.
